notes.title: Update 1.5.2 – Visibility option
notes.notes:
Update 1.5.2 Patch Notes



Visibility Changes: Added a new option in the Display Menu called "Shots". It lets you toggle between two color modes for player shots, scan, and slashing effects.

Bright Mode = effects appear orange

Muted Mode = effects match the background color



This picture showcases the color difference between Bright and Muted modes:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45308837/d24772a7ef3ce6c5902d7cebd43a1b0909e59bbb.png"]



UI Changes: Added descriptions to the top of the Display Menu to provide insight into the different options when they are selected.

notes.title: Update 1.5 – Dash indicator, QoL, bug fixes
notes.notes:
Update 1.5 Patch Notes



Gameplay

Added an indicator to show whether the player has dashes remaining (the player appears as a single color when out of dashes) 


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45308837/abe450df28c7fe1e9c970af92bfe36492048c74d.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45308837/36ba2441882ca583645d11dea71e23f8195415aa.png"]

Some bosses now display a larger central target when fully locked-on by the scan 



HUD

Added an option to display the HUD at the bottom of the screen for better visibility

The HUD now becomes transparent when the character moves behind it, to avoid obscuring the player

 

VFX

The slash effect from scanning and dashing is now longer and wider



Bug Fixes

Corrected a typo on the reward screen

Corrected a bug where extra line breaks were added to texts in both the tutorial and credits

Fixed a bug where certain projectile contact behaviors would trigger multiple times when dashing through them (e.g. the small mines from level 3)

Fixed a bug where some enemies were not displayed correctly when sliced

notes.title: Small bug fix!
notes.notes: Fixed a crash that can occur during the stage 5 boss fight if you stay near the edge of the screen.

notes.title: Update 1.3 – Non-integer scaling, gameplay + scoring changes, balancing
notes.notes:
Update 1.3 Patch Notes

Display

 The fullscreen option now uses Exclusive Fullscreen and non-integer scaling (this means the game will try to fit the entire screen in this setting and should also reduce input lag)


Gameplay

 You now create a small circular area at the end of each dash that clears projectiles for a fraction of a second. This should make dashing safer, as it gives you more time to readjust to the situation
 Dash now deals slightly more damage
 Enemies now blink when near death, indicating they can be killed with a single dash


Scoring

 You now start losing your chain multiplier after a 1.5s delay. Touching enemies with your shot, using your dash, and collecting HP pickups resets this duration. This allows you to maintain your multiplier across the entire level for a much higher score
 Your overall multiplier is now capped at ×16
 Reaching certain score thresholds rewards you with +1 HP (250000, 500000, 1000000, 2000000). Your score will become brighter and orange when you get close to these thresholds
 Style points are now awarded one by one during chains
 Bosses now display a timer in the top-right corner of your screen
 Using a non-damaging dash during a boss fight incurs a 20s penalty to the timer
 You are awarded points based on the time left when you defeat the boss
 Some transitions have been shortened slightly to prevent breaking your slice chain


Balancing
Level 2

 Various enemies no longer deal contact damage
 Some attacks from the midboss have been toned down in both Novice and Arcade mode
 The boss now uses aimed projectiles in Phases 1 and 3 instead of random bursts of projectiles


Level 3

 The Eel's fire rate has been reduced
 The Jellyfish wave now behaves differently to be slightly more dangerous
 The Brain bonus boss no longer deals contact damage


Visibility

 Jellyfish in the background of Level 3 have been resprited to be less distracting
 Shockwave attacks in Level 3 are now slightly brighter.
 Missile projectiles have been resprited to be brighter.
 The first boss's laser is now displayed on a lower layer so it does not hide projectiles during the fight.
 The tentacles of Jellyfish enemies are now brighter.


Music

 The track Hope of Molybdion was changed for better mixing.


Bug Fixes

 Fixed a crash that occurred when using the mouse to spam-click certain buttons.

notes.title: Lilac 0 Version 1.2
notes.notes:
The Level 2 boss no longer deals 2 damage with some of its projectiles.

 You can no longer trigger the Level 3 boss overkill and the basic level end simultaneously.

 The Level 4 boss no longer duplicates when overkilled quickly twice.

 The tentacles of the squid miniboss now travel the shortest distance when you go behind it.

 You can no longer enter an empty name on the result screen.

 The "End" button is selected by default on the result screen once you've registered a name.
 
 The Mentis Ray enemy has been re-sprited to avoid looking like an orange enemy when it isn’t.

 Some background transitions have been shortened in Levels 3 and 4 to maintain pacing.

 The final boss now awards fewer points to prevent flooding the leaderboards.
 
 Corrected a bug where the 1CC reward would be awarded even after using a continue coin.

notes.title: Update 1.1 – Tate mode, new music, bug fixes
notes.notes:
Update 1.1 Patch Notes


 Added new intro music, composed by BauKo
 Tate options for vertical monitors is now available under Options > Display > Rotate
 The last stage selected is now auto-selected when returning to the Stage Select screen 
 Bug fixed: players can no longer access locked levels
 Bug fixed: achievements now display correctly when unlocked
 Added some visual flair to scan mode
 Various small QoL changes to the menus
